records.whole_exchange_context:

AF gives in and asks what to do. AE orders AF to buy as many bananas as possible;AF responds with an offhand repeated acknowledgment. AE repeats the grand prediction and ends with a distinctive self-satisfied laugh. The closing FE notice predicts that bananas seem likely to become fashionable in セビリア. Preserve enthusiasm,doubt,insistence,compliance,purchase order,offhand response and extravagant confidence as a complete progression, then the shift to impersonal prospective news. Native AE/AF names,voices,ownership and approved city/commodity wording remain to bind. Do not name the speakers from an older English draft,assign a royal or military rank,or infer marriage,kinship,employment or a formal servant relationship. The feminine/assertive register and elaborate laugh characterize the first speaker without proving noble status. The second speaker moves from polite uncertainty to casual acquiescence;do not flatten every reply into the same formal yes.

Here いける concerns the taste catching on/succeeding as a fashion,not being physically edible,safe to eat,or already sold profitably. The purchase order is as many as can be bought,not an invented quantity,price,available capital,ship-hold capacity or cargo transaction already completed. Keep the first speaker's certainty as her own boast and the FE notice's しそう as prospective likelihood, not a narrator-confirmed existing boom or observed earned state. The notice names セビリア only at the close;do not insert it into earlier speeches or assign the conversation an unproven location. Preserve bananas as the concrete subject and the humor of an age-of-bananas proclamation without adding sexual innuendo or a new joke.
